description: Original dinic mod.rs with bounded correspondence models.
state: Directed u64-capacity edges and distinct indexed terminals, V and E at most 1,000,000. Return existing max_flow::Flow: u128 value, per-edge flows and residual source-side mask.
cost: O(V+E) initialization; each phase has O(V+E) failed scans and at most E paths of length at most V. Fewer than V reachable-sink phases: conservative O(V^2 E+V^2+E) time, O(V+E) storage. No recursion. u128 total <=1,000,000*u64::MAX; Overflow defensive under caps/invariants. Allocation failure untyped.
forward: Reject size caps, source, sink, same terminal, then first invalid edge. Allocate paired residual arcs. FIFO BFS fixes levels; monotone cursors and explicit path backtracking exhaust blocking flows. Augment bottlenecks with checked arithmetic. Return reverse residuals and final BFS reachability.
inverse: U is declared inputs/errors crossed with outputs. C=U minus forward relation R includes wrong first errors, infeasible witnesses and wrong optima/canonical fields. Exact specification, partial Rust correspondence only. Each residual pair sums to original capacity. Flows respect capacities and conserve mass off terminals. Level paths strictly increase depth; loops have zero flow. Final saturated cut certifies optimum; source-side mask equals residual reachability.

Pre(y)={x in domain | R(x,y)} preserves every compatible input. Traversal history is omitted, graph redundancy creates multiple antecedents, and errors have whole first-failure fibers. No unique inverse or reconstruction executor claimed.
limitations: Finite evidence, not a general proof; allocation failures unmodeled.
Partial syntax excludes macro expansion and semantic resolution.
